{{Top|leg}}
A '''spraynet''' was a liquefied web that was fired from [[Snare rifle/Legends|snare rifles]]. It would cover a target and solidify to hold the victim in place. The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[GRS-1 snare rifle/Legends|GRS-1 snare rifle]] utilized a liquid spraynet which was fired immediately following a [[shockstun mist]].

The fibers of the spraynet were difficult to break. The GRS-1 liquid spraynet dispenser cost 25 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and could fire up to twelve shots before the cartridge must be replaced.<ref name="HtOHH">{{GamerCite|6|How the Other Half Hunts}}</ref>

[[Stokhli/Legends|Stokhli]] [[Spray stick/Legends|spray sticks]] fired a thin translucent [[spraymist]] that transformed into a liquid when exposed to cool air. The liquid quickly became a solid cylindrical net that was called a spraynet.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
